issue.note: R007: F001 requires a change outside R007. E003 and E004 state estimates in Hsrc^s and L2src, but no supplied definition specifies these spaces, their norms, or their identification with H^s and L2. D003 and D004 define only the target spaces. Consequently target-space membership does not establish the source hypotheses, and the asserted identity 'Source norms are sqrt(2*pi) times ours' cannot be derived from the fixed packet. Preserving the supplied source-application proof route requires amending the shared definitions or the E003/E004 public input statements to specify the source spaces and justify their carrier/norm identification with D003/D004 (or equivalently state the justified estimates in the existing target spaces). Choosing a sufficiently small epsilon in place of 1/8 cannot supply this missing identification. No shared input or definition has been changed here.

resolution.note: Added shared definitions D024 and D025 at /spec/definitions/23 and /spec/definitions/24 specifying the source distributions, full Fourier norms, unnormalized measure and time conventions. E002–E004 directly select these definitions. R007 S001 proves equality of carriers by the identity on Fourier coefficients and polynomial completions, obtains the exact sqrt(2*pi) norm equality, and exports the universally quantified F001. S002 now cites F001, verifies w's source membership, identifies the stage operator and converts both source output norms. A001–A003 state these actual grounds. R006 has the same local normalization proof/F001 for its trilinear conversion. The primary PDF's norm definitions were read and match the new records; no added assumption or changed target is involved.
